subject: FinOptima security intake — combined SOC 2 + pen test + DPA walkthrough

From: Sam Park <sam.park@finoptima.com>

Cc: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@finoptima.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA walkthrough — request and availability

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — FinOptima is keen to move forward with the intake. We'd like to schedule a single walkthrough that covers: SOC 2 scope discussion, pen test logistics (vendor interface and timing), and the DPA review/controls mapping. Our security ops team will join (cc'd Lina).

Availability windows this week: Mon-Wed 11:00–15:00 PST, or Thu 08:00–10:00 PST. We prefer a 60–75 minute slot if possible.

I've attached our short pre-intake questionnaire to help focus the call. Could your team confirm who will be on the call and what evidence extracts (if any) we should prepare ahead of time?

Attachments:
- finoptima_prelim_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks —
Sam Park
Security Program Manager
FinOptima
[sam.park@finoptima.com]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@finoptima.com>
Cc: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@finoptima.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Feb 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA walkthrough — request and availability

Hi Sam — great to hear, excited to get this on the calendar.

We can cover all three topics in a single session. Proposed structure (60–75 min):
- 0–10m: intros & scope confirmation (SOC 2 in-scope systems, pen vendor touchpoints)
- 10–35m: controls / DPA mapping and data flows (Camila + Olga)
- 35–60m: pen test logistics, timeline, evidence handoff (me + Camila)
- 60–75m: open Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

Attendees from Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (Security/Compliance), Olga Petrov (Platform Reliability / evidence owner), Camila Reyes (Eng operations / pen-test liaison).

We can do Tue or Wed 11:30–12:45 PST — does Tue 2028-02-07 11:30 PST work for you? If you prefer Thursday morning we can also open 02/09 at 08:30 PST.

Prep items we need from you before the call:
- Confirm the model of testing (internal vs. third-party vendor) and vendor contact if external.
- High level list of in-scope product endpoints and data classification (PII/PHI/other).
- Any required network allowlists or temporary test credentials we should plan for.

We can also share a short evidence checklist and a sample logs extraction script after you confirm the slot.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Security (Redwood Inference)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA walkthrough — coordination notes

Folks — forwarding FinOptima thread. Key points: proposed Tue/Wed 11:30 slot or Thu 08:30; they prefer a single combined session.

Olga: can you pull the evidence checklist I used for LedgerSafe last quarter and adapt it for FinOptima? Focus on access logs, RBAC snapshots, and KMS key usage summaries.
Camila: please prepare the notes on how we handle vendor pen tests (staging creds, canary tokens, and expected timelines). Also flag any expected capacity or bridges we should book — FinOptima is in the US so block a standard 90-min ops bridge just in case.

I'll confirm the slot once Sam replies.

Thanks —
Rishi
